explanation: The story first appeared in 1876, four years after Webb Ellis died, and no account from the time supports it. The Rugby World Cup trophy bears his name.

claims.text: There is no good evidence that William Webb Ellis invented rugby by picking up the ball and running with it in 1823.
The Webb Ellis story was first published in 1876 by Matthew Bloxam, four years after Webb Ellis died in 1872.
No account written in 1823 records Webb Ellis running with the ball.
The Rugby World Cup trophy is called the Webb Ellis Cup.
